items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So this contract that you had with Lucille... she was trying to sell you as an act at that point? ... Well, she was.

ctx.x: With Lucille Achet, see. She was supposed to come up some -- maybe some while later, you know. She was maybe a year or so -- she was going to come up and join us, travel sometime with us, you know. See, we weren't just going to always stay in New York City, but New York City was like headquarters, you see. That came about after Nat Nazarro discovered us, you see.
So this contract that you had with Lucille, what was she doing to promote you in any way? What was your obligation? Was she trying to sell you as an act at that point?

Well, she was. That's what she does, you see, because she had the record shop there in Atlanta, Georgia, but I mean she was a very important woman. You understand? She's very popular. You see? I mean throughout the United States, you see, as a businesswoman, you see, and -- and through her father-in-Law, you know, and she was actually in the money world, you see, and important companies like record companies and so forth like that, theatrical people, she knew most of them, see? I mean --
